faqs.q: What is the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve and what does it do?
faqs.a: The Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve is a direct-acting, balanced-spool 4-way valve — the cartridge equivalent of a small directional valve. Two-position versions have one coil and a choice of spools; three-position versions have a coil at each end and centre on springs. No minimum pressure is needed to shift. It is rated 8 gpm (30 L/min) at up to 5000 psi (350 bar).

faqs.q: How do I read the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve model code and its option letters?
faqs.a: DNCAZ is the base model in series 1. The letters after it choose the spool or poppet configuration (C — Closed; Shift to Through; X — Cross), the seal (N — Buna-N; V — Viton) and the coil. For example DNCAZXN. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

faqs.q: What flow, series and cavity does the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve have?
faqs.a: The DNCAZ is series 1, fits the T-31A cavity and is rated 8 gpm (30 L/min). Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop.

faqs.q: How is the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve configured, and what should I check before choosing it?
faqs.a: For the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve, the configuration letter chooses the function: C — Closed, Shift to Through, X — Cross, Shift to Through, A — A to T, Shift to Through, B — B to T, Shift to Through, J — Open. Spool options set the flow paths in each position — closed, open, through, cross; choose from the configuration letters.

faqs.q: What pressure, leakage and response ratings does the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve have?
faqs.a: The DNCAZ is rated to a maximum operating pressure of 5000 psi (350 bar). Maximum leakage is 10 in³/min.@3000 psi (160 cc/min.@210 bar). Typical response time is 50 ms. Switching frequency is 15,000 max. cycles/hr. Pressure and flow are limited by the lowest-rated part of your circuit.

faqs.q: What seal materials and coil voltages does the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve offer?
faqs.a: For the DNCAZ, the seal material options are N — Buna-N, V — Viton. Coil: 13 coil choices, or no coil — 12 VDC, 14 VDC, 24 VDC, 28 VDC, 115 VAC, 230 VAC; connections include DIN 43650-Form A, Metri-Pack, Deutsch DT04-2P. Fitting a different external seal does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built.

faqs.q: Which cavity does the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve fit?
faqs.a: The Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve fits Sun's T-series cavity T-31A. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in the same series shares that cavity, and the seal kits for that series fit it.

faqs.q: Does the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve come with a coil, and what do I need to run it?
faqs.a: The coil is chosen with its own code, voltage and connector, and can be supplied fitted or ordered separately for the DNCAZ. Tell us the voltage and the connector your machine uses and we confirm the coil with the quotation. The range offers 13 coil choices.

faqs.q: What torque and seal kits apply to the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve?
faqs.a: Screw the DNCAZ into its cavity with a 7/8 in. (22,2 mm) hex, tightened to 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm). Replacement seal kits: series 1: Buna: 990431007, Viton: 990431006. Only the external seals can be serviced.

faqs.q: Where is the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve used?
faqs.a: The DNCAZ is used for: double-acting cylinders and motors, and pilot control of larger directional cartridges. The armature runs wet in the working fluid, so on long duty cycles check the fluid temperature limit.

faqs.q: How does the Sun DNCAZ 4-way solenoid-operated directional spool valve differ from the Sun DNCA?
faqs.a: The nearest sibling is the [Sun DNCA](/p/sun-hydraulics-dnca-4-way-2-position-solenoid-operated-directional-spool-valve-closed-transition), and the difference is as follows. The DNCAZ is the position switch version (a position switch confirms the valve is in its spring position). Check the model code of your old valve to pick the right one.
